id: # The 21 generic events of events.md (guide book p.56 to p.83). One row for each event; the engine has one handler for each key.
# check: quarter (day 1 of the months in months), month (day 1 of each month), search (after 探索人材), wait (after 待命 of a unit), none.
# min_days: the days since the start. chance: percent at each check; most are assumed (Q-184). p1..p6: the numbers of the trigger and the effect, in the order of the handler (tutorial 20).
# names: the Big5 hex of the officers that the event names (the traveller first), | between names.
# transport_arrived: the question when a transport of the player reaches its city (G2-027): 0 the officers stay, 1 they return to the home city. The code asks it; no check fires it.
